title: Bounded multi-cell TABLECONTENT scalar grid writer

scope.operation: Write a bounded rectangular standalone TABLECONTENT grid with plain scalar cells.
scope.profile: Generated 2x2 string-value grid, including an empty first cell; ASCII and binary DXF.
preserved_refusals: Multi-cell block references and ATTDEF attributes
scope.claim_boundary: Serializer and typed DXF readback evidence only; no native table rendering or DWG encoding claim.

implementation: Removed the unconditional 1x1 column/row/cell writer gate for bounded rectangular scalar grids.
Emit each column, row, cell, custom scope, content list, and supported cell format transactionally using existing scalar codecs.
Validate rectangular dimensions, per-grid limits, metadata shape, and scalar cell properties before output.
Preserve the existing single-cell source-bound linked, block, and FIELD writer path.

evidence.typed_readback: Exact 2x2 dimensions and three populated string values; the empty first cell remains empty.
evidence.failure_control: A non-finite scalar in the second row is refused; destination sentinel and caller model remain unchanged.
evidence.retry_control: The same writer succeeds after restoring the corrected cell and the result reads back.

remaining: The parent P5 rendering/TABLE phase remains open.
Multi-cell source-bound reference profiles and broader TABLE semantics require separate reproduced witnesses and receipts.
